item.title: Auto vs. Train in Pct. 4
item.description: HARRIS COUNTY, TX- Deputies with the Harris County Constable Precinct 4 responded last night to a motor vehicle accident involving a train near the intersection of Kuykendahl Road and Kuykendahl Huffsmith Road.
